L3-0001.hanzi: 大家的爱心让他很感动。

L3-0058.english: Whatever you are doing, do it properly.

L3-0115.hanzi: 这些年轻人创造了很多新的作品。

L3-0115.english: These young people have created a great many new works.

L3-0171.hanzi: 他在报纸上发表了一篇文章。
L3-0171.pinyin: tā zài bào zhǐ shàng fā biǎo le yì piān wén zhāng
L3-0171.english: He published an article in the newspaper.

L3-0283.english: Please read the first line of characters out once.

L3-0339.hanzi: 他坚决反对这个新计划。

L3-0339.english: He is firmly opposed to this new plan.

L3-0395.english: Employment for university graduates is looking good this year.

L3-0451.english: Several schools jointly organised this competition.

L3-0507.english: Inside he was extremely nervous, but he didn't say so.

L3-0563.hanzi: 过节的时候，他最想念的是亲人。
L3-0563.pinyin: guò jié de shí hou tā zuì xiǎng niàn de shì qīn rén
L3-0563.english: At festival time, the ones he misses most are his family.

L3-0620.hanzi: 这座桥是他父亲设计的。
L3-0620.pinyin: zhè zuò qiáo shì tā fù qīn shè jì de
L3-0620.english: This bridge was designed by his father.

L3-0676.english: He was injured during the match and is still in hospital.

L3-0732.hanzi: 只有团结起来，我们才能成功。

L3-0732.english: Only by pulling together can we succeed.

L4-0657.hanzi: 手术很成功，病人已经醒了。

L4-0937.pinyin: bié zháo jí hái yǒu bàn ge xiǎo shí

L5-0105.hanzi: 这项措施已经取得了明显的成效。

L5-0610.hanzi: 大家都劝他别放弃这个机会。

L5-0778.hanzi: 公司还没有对外界公布这个消息。

L5-1002.hanzi: 这个问题还在讨论之中。
L5-1002.pinyin: zhè ge wèn tí hái zài tǎo lùn zhī zhōng

L5-1058.hanzi: 她今天穿了一件紫色的裙子。

L5-1058.english: She is wearing a purple skirt today.
